import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize label variants / extra spaces
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # ensure numeric columns are numeric (some values may be text)
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # body_mass_g out of allowed range [2500, 6500] -> treat as invalid (NaN)
    bad = (df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500)
    df.loc[bad, 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df[df['sex'].notna() & df['body_mass_g'].notna()]
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
